title: Follow directed labeled application flows
preconditions: Use authored Data flows board with separate authoring, reading and review paths; reviewer has corresponding source handlers, persistence writes and failure branches available.

steps.action: Follow each directed labeled path from input through services and transformations to stores.
steps.expected_result: Arrows and labels explain the order and meaning of movement through key services, transformations and stores.

steps.action: Compare authoring, reading and review persistence and failure boundaries against implementation.
steps.expected_result: The board explains the different boundaries and does not imply read-only actions persist application changes.
